episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: Five-year-old Amaya disappears during a Christmas parade in Málaga and the case catches the attention of Miren, an intern at the local newspaper.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: In 2016, six years after Amaya vanished, a mysterious video reopens the case. In 2010, the police investigate a family friend with a suspicious past.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: Diario Sur publishes the video of Amaya after Miren strikes a deal with Millán, leading to a flood of new tips and a potential suspect.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: James Foster gives Miren disturbing information that opens up a new line of inquiry. In 2019, a second video appears, making Ana fear the worst.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: The past nine years look very different from the perspective of Amaya's kidnappers. And as the search intensifies, they grow increasingly desperate.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: Miren herself becomes a target of suspicion but refuses to give up on the search for Amaya, even when it takes her into serious danger.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: After receiving a mysterious letter, Miren tries to link a teen's murder to an old disappearance, clashing with Eduardo. Jaime arrives at the newspaper.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: A tragedy hits hard. Miren tracks a powerful family in Málaga while keeping an eye on Los Arcos School. A new message opens the door to the Soul Game.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: Jaime comes upon a witness to Laura's last day. Miren discovers another victim of the game — but the journalist persists and dives into her first test.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: An influential visit to Diario Sur obstructs the investigation. Police have Laura's uncle in the spotlight. Miren relives the worst night of her life.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: Belén and Miren cross paths. Los Arcos' principal faces mounting pressure, which turns Nacho against his family. The game makes new demands.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: With Miren's life on the line, Jaime's search takes him to the Green House, where shocking secrets about the investigation come to light.
